messages.subject: For Troy Hey | Corporate relations, social performance and responsible-growth execution
messages.body:
Dear MMG Corporate Affairs Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Troy Hey, Executive General Manager, Corporate Relations.

MMG's global portfolio depends on strong corporate relations and social-performance execution across very different operating environments. The value of external relationships is highest when community, regulator and stakeholder commitments remain tightly connected to operating accountability.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I manage high-scrutiny commitments through clear ownership, evidence, timelines and escalation across operations, environment, HSE, legal, HR, finance, procurement and technical teams.

I would value a conversation about where this operator-side experience might support MMG's corporate-relations, social-performance, stakeholder or country-facing leadership priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
